about: Halogen server running Qwen3.8-27B on a Ryzen AI Max (Radeon 8060S) from unified RAM; OpenAI chat API on port 8731
setup: NEEDS: a Ryzen AI Max (Radeon 8060S) with 128 GB of unified RAM; amd-smi reports the BIOS carve-out (512 MiB) as VRAM, so matching goes by GPU name and host RAM, not VRAM. The container needs /dev/kfd and /dev/dri with group access to the render nodes by host GID (the image defines no video/render groups); the engine loads and passes every gate under the default seccomp profile, private IPC and the default memlock limit, so no privileged options remain. host_ram_gb is the system-wide MemAvailable drop at server ready, measured on Arch/Omarchy with ROCm from /opt/rocm. host_ram_gb is 21 (MemAvailable drop idle->ready; the weights beyond it serve from evictable unified-memory page cache).
